entries.14dc16780b1e97e6: This business develops and sells cosmetics containing the cosmetic raw material "Neosilk®-Human-Type Collagen I." It is carried out by the consolidated subsidiary Neosilk Cosmetics Co., Ltd., which sells mainly through domestic mail order. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2 million.
entries.16838477d1533ea2: The group consists of Immuno-Biological Laboratories Co., Ltd. and its consolidated subsidiaries Neosilk Cosmetics Co., Ltd. and AI Bio Co., Ltd., and is headquartered in Fujioka, Gunma Prefecture. Consolidated headcount is 54 employees (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.173fe1d5cff6f9fb: This business provides antibody-based reagents and testing services, and produces proteins using genetically modified silkworms. It consists of three parts: diagnostic reagent services, testing services and TG silkworm services. Its main facilities are the head office (Fujioka Research Institute) in Fujioka, Gunma Prefecture, the Mikasa Research Institute in Mikasa, Hokkaido, and the Maebashi Research Institute in Maebashi, Gunma Prefecture. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,002 million.
